title: Live: SportsCenter
description: The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on "SportsCenter," ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new midnight show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live "SportsCenter" morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms.

title: Live: College GameDay
description: Originating from the site of one of the day's best matchups, with a sea of fans cheering wildly in the background, host Rece Davis and analysts Lee Corso, Kirk Herbstreit and Desmond Howard talk college football for three hours, reporting on the top teams, games, players and storylines. David Pollack and Maria Taylor contribute reports, interviews and features. Davis replaced longtime host Chris Fowler in 2015.

title: Live: College Football
description: The SMU Mustangs (7-2, 5-2 ACC) host the No. 13 Wake Forest Demon Deacons (8-1, 5-1 ACC) at Gerald J. Ford Stadium in Dallas. Wake Forest aims for a seven-game win streak behind Gio Lopez, while SMU recently defeated Virginia Tech, 51-28.

title: Live: College Football
description: The No. 8 Tennessee Volunteers (7-2) visit the Texas A&M Aggies (4-5) at Kyle Field. Tennessee enters this matchup after beating Kentucky, 34-6, while Texas A&M seeks to snap a two-game skid after falling 17-9 to South Carolina in Week 10.

title: Live: Sunday NFL Countdown
description: This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes.

title: Live: College Basketball
description: The No. 10 Louisville Cardinals (2-0) visit the Memphis Tigers (2-1) at FedExForum for a college basketball game. Louisville aims for a three-game win streak behind Adrian Wooley, while Memphis relies on Jayden Reid who leads with 23 points.

title: Live: College Basketball
description: The Baylor Bears face the No. 7 Texas Longhorns for an NCAA Division I game in Texas. Baylor rides a three-game win streak alongside guard Kayden Mingo, and Texas also rides a three-game win streak alongside center Matas Vokietaitis in San Antonio.

title: College Basketball Live Scoreboard
description: All the latest scores and highlights from college basketball.

title: Live: Women's College Basketball
description: The No. 7 Louisville Cardinals play the No. 4 UConn Huskies. Louisville looks to extend an undefeated start after holding Lindenwood to 35 points, while UConn relies on 11 three-pointers from a 12-point win on Nov. 9 to earn an away victory.
